repair.content: To obtain the displayed interpolation convention while keeping the formula phi=lambda_plus/Omega_plus+lambda_minus/Omega_minus, replace the projections by lambda_plus/minus(a)=[lambda(a) +/- (-1)^j lambda(-a)]/2, and normalize the cohomological periods consistently with those projections.
